How it works

KaribuFans connects you to the business. You pay them directly, not us.

1

Choose

Browse local stays, food spots, nightlife and rides in one place.

2

Book directly

Message the business on WhatsApp or call them, and pay them by M-Pesa.

3

Enjoy

Keep your plan on your phone. Rides open straight in the Uber or Bolt app.

For Nairobi businesses

Put your business in front of new customers.

No listing fee. You pay a commission only on customers we send you.
